summary.en: In a gas at thermal equilibrium, molecular speeds spread out over a characteristic distribution set by temperature and mass — most molecules cluster near a typical speed, with a tail of much faster and much slower ones.
summary.et: Termilises tasakaalus oleva gaasi molekulide kiirused jaotuvad temperatuurist ja massist sõltuva iseloomuliku jaotuse järgi — enamik molekule koondub tüüpilise kiiruse ümber, ent esineb ka palju kiiremaid ja aeglasemaid.
